title: Hera Syndulla
description: Hera Syndulla got her start fighting against oppression on Ryloth as a child and never stopped. As the captain of the Ghost, she assembled a makeshift family that included Kanan Jarrus, Sabine Wren, Ezra Bridger, "Zeb" Orrelios, and the Droid Chopper. Together, they fought against the Empire during the dark times. After the end of the Civil War she became a general in the New Republic and dedicated her service to keeping the galaxy safe. On top of the role of veteran and soldier, she kept up with the role of mother to her son Jacen.
